scripts.format: cd frontend && npm run format && cd ../backend && npm run format
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.version: conventional-changelog -p conventionalcommits --skip-unstable -i CHANGELOG.md -o CHANGELOG.md && git add CHANGELOG.md
scripts.release:major: cd backend && npm version major --commit-hooks false && cd ../frontend && npm version major --commit-hooks false && cd .. && git add . && npm version major --force -m 'release: %s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: cd backend && npm version minor --commit-hooks false && cd ../frontend && npm version minor --commit-hooks false && cd .. && git add . && npm version minor --force -m 'release: %s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:patch: cd backend && npm version patch --commit-hooks false && cd ../frontend && npm version patch --commit-hooks false && cd .. && git add . && npm version patch --force -m 'release: %s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:beta:major: cd backend && npm version premajor --preid beta --commit-hooks false && cd ../frontend && npm version premajor --preid beta --commit-hooks false && cd .. && git add . && npm version premajor --preid beta --force -m 'release: %s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:beta:minor: cd backend && npm version preminor --preid beta --commit-hooks false && cd ../frontend && npm version preminor --preid beta --commit-hooks false && cd .. && git add . && npm version preminor --preid beta --force -m 'release: %s' && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:beta:patch: cd backend && npm version prerelease --preid beta --commit-hooks false && cd ../frontend && npm version prerelease --preid beta --commit-hooks false && cd .. && git add . && npm version prerelease --preid beta --force -m 'release: %s' && git push && git push --tags
